collection.title: Audi 100 Saloon 1990 to 1994 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi 100 Saloon 1990 to 1994 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
